summary: Iteration 18 — frontend delete-visit flow verified on web preview. All 5 checks PASSED. Long-press on a map visit card opens the visit-context-menu, tapping ctx-delete opens the new confirm-delete-modal (with correct 'Delete this visit?' / 'cannot be undone' copy plus visible Cancel & Delete buttons). Cancel dismisses the modal and keeps the card. Confirm calls api.deleteVisit(), closes the modal, removes the card from the list, and the visit is confirmed gone from GET /api/visits/today. No relevant console errors — only 2 unrelated 401s (likely a stale token fetch pre-login, not related to deleteVisit). No red-screen errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert is referenced in error-fallback branches (commitEdit line ~158, performDelete line ~181, toggleBookmark line ~194) but Alert is NOT imported from 'react-native'. If any of those API calls throw, the app will hit a ReferenceError ('Alert is not defined'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/map.tsx:158,181,194 vs import block lines 2-13.

action_items: Add `Alert` to the react-native import in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/map.tsx (or replace the remaining Alert.alert calls with the same in-app modal pattern) to prevent ReferenceError on API failures in edit/delete/bookmark error paths.
critical_code_review_comments: map.tsx is ~1520 lines — approaching the 700-line soft limit; consider splitting the modals (context menu, confirm-delete, edit-visit, attach-project, visit-detail) into their own components for readability.
Delete confirm modal implementation is correct and platform-safe on web.
seed_data_creation: Created one ephemeral visit `DELETE_ME_iter18` via POST /api/visits and deleted it during the test — no leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delete-visit fix verified. If Alert import bug is fixed by main agent, also verify by forcing a failed patchVisit/deleteVisit (e.g. bad id) to ensure the fallback UI shows a proper message instead of throwing.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: Alert.alert multi-button destructive callback does not fire on React Native Web, so 'Delete' button in Alert dialog silently no-op'd. Fix (verified working): replaced Alert.alert confirm with in-app Modal (`confirm-delete-modal`) using explicit Pressable buttons wired directly to performDelete() → api.deleteVisit(). Delete now works on web and native.
